text: BERLINCLOCK points at the set-theory clock in Berlin, whose lamps count hours and minutes in fives and ones. Its lamps could drive a key, one setting per letter.
Moving one minute per letter, places 22 and 23 leave constants 22 and 4: they differ, so this schedule is dead.
Lit lamps, hour, minute, their sum, the five-minute row and the time digits, steps of 1 to 30 minutes, every start: at most 8 of 24 known places agree, as on shuffled coppers.
